title: DIR-009: Multi-Portal Route Synchronization, Dedicated Shell Isolation & ContextSwitcher Integration
spec:
# SECTION 1 — EXECUTIVE MANDATE
Directive ID: DIR-009
Title: DIR-009: Multi-Portal Route Synchronization, Dedicated Shell Isolation & ContextSwitcher Integration
Target Workspace: d:\xampp\htdocs\IME365
Priority: P0 (Critical Architecture, Routing & Multi-Portal Navigation)

## Objective:
1. Eliminate the double-shell collision where Admin (/admin), Enterprise (/org), and Employer (/employer) are wrapped in CubaAppShell and display the Candidate Workspace sidebar.
2. Implement adaptive portal shell behavior or dedicated shells so each of the 4 platform portals renders its authentic navigation rail.
3. Restore the global ContextSwitcher (portal persona switcher) in the top header and user profile dropdown.
4. Wire canonical sub-routes and bidirectional URL state synchronization for:
   - Admin Console: /admin, /admin/:tab (dashboard, health, queues, operations, attention, users, support, security, moderation, blog, content, ai-settings, email)
   - Employer Portal: /employer, /employer/jobs, /employer/applicants, /employer/messages, /employer/company, /employer/settings
   - Enterprise Console: /org, /org/:slug, /org/:slug/:tab
5. Implement the missing Candidate Messages view (/employer/messages) in the Employer Portal.

# SECTION 2 — MANDATORY IMPLEMENTATION WORKFLOW (PLAN -> ACT)
2.1 PLAN MODE:
- Developer inspects frontend/src/app/router.tsx, frontend/src/components/layout/cuba-app-shell.tsx, frontend/src/pages/admin/console.tsx, frontend/src/pages/employer/portal.tsx, frontend/src/pages/enterprise/console.tsx, and legacy src/components/common/ContextSwitcher.jsx.
- Submit structured plan via 'bridge dev plan' with summary and steps.
2.2 ACT MODE:
- Upon Lead plan approval, implement surgical modifications.
- Run npm run build and Playwright tests across deep links.
- Submit evidence via 'bridge dev submit-evidence'.
invariants: ZERO DOUBLE-SHELLING: Admin, Enterprise, and Employer consoles must NEVER render the Candidate Workspace sidebar on their primary navigation rail.
CANONICAL DEEP-LINK INTEGRITY: Direct URLs (/admin/:tab, /employer/:section) must restore the exact target view upon reload.
STRICT RBAC & DATA ISOLATION: Admin routes require ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN; Enterprise enforces X-Tenant-Id; Employer requires authenticated recruiter session.
WCAG 2.1 AA & CUBA M3 SYSTEM: Accessible landmarks, high contrast >= 4.5:1, and consistent glassmorphic styling tokens.
PERFORMANCE BUDGET: Frontend build compiles under 3.0s with zero compilation errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Adaptive Portal Shell or Dedicated Shells: Refactor CubaAppShell or create dedicated shells so Admin (/admin), Employer (/employer), and Enterprise (/org) portals display their authentic navigation rails without candidate sidebar double-shelling.
Restore Global ContextSwitcher in header and user dropdown allowing eligible users to switch between Candidate, Employer, Enterprise, and Admin portals.
Bidirectional Route & URL State Synchronization in router.tsx: /admin/:tab, /employer/:section, and /org/:slug/:tab deep-links load the correct view on reload.
Employer Portal Parity: Add /employer/messages, /employer/jobs, /employer/applicants, /employer/company, and /employer/settings sub-routes with active status.
TypeScript compiler (tsc -b) passes with 0 errors and npm run build compiles cleanly within budget.
